WITH observatory_shares AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
  FROM observatory_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(telescope_count) AS combined_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) AS average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM (
  SELECT os.share, a.avg_share, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatory_shares AS os
  CROSS JOIN average_share AS a
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = os.observstation
  WHERE os.share > a.avg_share
  GROUP BY os.observstation, os.share, a.avg_share
)
